data.analysis_policy: Compare native-response unweighted power-law least squares y=a*x**b with ordinary least squares of log(y) on intercept+log(x),back-transforming by exp without a smearing factor. The scientific target is squared error in original energy response units. Suggested native start a0.7,b4; do not compare R-squared across response scales.
data.units: x=absolute temperature in1000K; y=source radiated energy per cm² per second,source energy unit unspecified.
